decisions.wiring: registry advertises verbose; handler passes args.verbose; provider reads options.verbose into the report; formatter prints the verbose sections only when verbose=true
decisions.bidirectional: verbose=true output contains the per-language breakdown and stale/missing file names; verbose=false output contains neither

limitations: The stale-file name list reflects the sampled freshness check (default sampled mode), which is the advertised behavior.
